name: easymysql
description: MariaDB/MySQL databases for Codex: schema, read-only queries and safe changes through the EasyMySQL MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage your MariaDB databases
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the MariaDB server in EasyMySQL. Codex reads schemas, runs read-only queries in a READ ONLY transaction and, when you allow it in EasyMySQL, changes data with an automatic backup before destructive statements.
defaultPrompt: Show me the tables in my database and how they are related.
